YATRA ONLINE Q1 ; GROSS BOOKINGS GROW 16.5%, HOTEL ROOM NIGHTS SURGE ~30% — MICE BUSINESS IMPACTS EBITDA

• ✈️ Gross bookings grew 16.5% YoY to ₹2,100.7 Cr, with total Air & H&P transactions up 12.2%

• 🏨 Room nights jumped ~30% YoY, supported by continued expansion of hotel supply

• 💰 Gross Margin (RLSC) grew 6.1% YoY to ₹122.7 Cr

• 📉 EBITDA declined 45.6% YoY to ₹13.2 Cr, impacted by Middle East conflict-related weakness in international MICE and lower airline-related income

• 🏢 Added 53 corporate customers with annual billable potential of ₹222.3 Cr; MSME-focused team added 30+ new clients

• 🤖 AI-powered expense management platform RECAP reached 20 cumulative customers

• 📈 Q2 MICE pipeline is 50%+ higher than Q1, indicating potential recovery in activity

• 🌍 Signed a 7-year strategic partnership with Kanoo Travel, marking a major international expansion of Yatra’s enterprise travel technology platform into the Middle East

UVS HOSPITALITY ACQUIRES 34.76% STAKE IN CALCIO RESTAURANTS VIA ₹23.87 CR SHARE SWAP

• 🍽️ Acquired 34.76% stake in Calcio Restaurants Private Limited on a fully diluted basis

• 💰 Acquisition consideration stands at ₹23.87 Cr, entirely through a share swap

• 📊 UVS Hospitality allotted 23,87,257 equity shares on a preferential basis to Calcio shareholders

• 🏨 Calcio operates in the hotels & restaurants business and has a presence in Mumbai

• 📈 Calcio reported FY25 turnover of approximately ₹5.20 Cr, versus ₹2.78 Cr in FY24

• 🤝 Transaction is aimed at business consolidation, operational synergies, balance-sheet strengthening and future growth opportunities

🟢 Outlook: Positive – Strategic investment expands UVS Hospitality's exposure to the restaurant business, with potential operational synergies and growth opportunities.

FRONTIER SPRINGS Q1 ; MAINTAINS ₹500 CR FY27 REVENUE GUIDANCE, EXPECTS Q1 EXECUTION SHORTFALL TO RECOVER

• ⚠️ Q1 performance impacted by industrial gas shortages and delays in procurement of air spring bellows, resulting in lower capacity utilisation

• ✅ Supply disruptions now resolved; plant operations and supply chains have fully normalised entering Q2

• 📈 Demand remains firm across business verticals with a strong order pipeline

• 💰 Softening raw material prices expected to support margins in coming quarters

• 🎯 Management maintains FY27 gross revenue guidance of ₹500 Cr and expects deferred Q1 execution to be recovered during the year

• 🚆 Coil springs & air springs demand remains steady, supported by railway procurement; forging business seeing improving orders

• 🛠️ Received RDSO approval as a developmental vendor for FIBA systems; preparing samples covering 25 coach sets for a 12-month trial

• 🚀 Successful FIBA trials could pave the way for commercial-scale orders, creating a new long-term growth opportunity

RAYMOND REALTY INCORPORATES NEW WHOLLY-OWNED SUBSIDIARY FOR REAL ESTATE PROJECTS

• 🏢 Incorporated Ten X Mahalaxmi Limited (TXML) as a wholly-owned subsidiary on August 12, 2026

• 🏗️ New entity will undertake real estate projects, particularly redevelopment of old/mid-sized projects

• 💰 Raymond Realty subscribed to 10,000 equity shares of ₹10 each, investing ₹1 lakh

• 📊 Raymond Realty holds 100% ownership in the new subsidiary

• 🎯 Move is aimed at exploring and executing new real estate opportunities

🟢 Outlook: Positive – New subsidiary expands Raymond Realty's platform for pursuing redevelopment and other real estate opportunities.

SANSERA ENGINEERING Q1 ; TARGETS HIGH-TEENS FY27 REVENUE GROWTH, FOCUS ON MARGIN IMPROVEMENT

• 📈 Q1 revenue hit an all-time high of ₹1,021.3 Cr, up 33.3% YoY

• 💰 Maintained healthy EBITDA margin of 19.2% and PAT margin of 8.6% despite cost inflation and geopolitical challenges

• 🚀 Non-Auto business achieved record sales; contribution increased to 20.8%, led by 3x+ YoY growth in ADS

• ⚡ Auto-Tech Agnostic & xEV business grew 22.2% YoY, while Auto-ICE grew 20.8% YoY

• 📚 New business order book excluding ADS stood at ₹1,849.3 Cr, while ADS unexecuted backlog stood at ₹4,436.8 Cr

• 🏭 Company plans to build capacity ahead of strong demand, supported by new qualifications and strong OEM relationships

• 🎯 Management expects to end FY27 with high-teens topline growth, alongside continued improvement in margins

SANSERA ENGINEERING Q1 ; RECORD REVENUE, NON-AUTO SALES SURGE 130% YOY

• 📈 Delivered highest-ever quarterly revenue, with stable EBITDA and PAT margins

• 🇮🇳 India business grew 17.4% YoY, while international business surged 71.4% YoY

• 🚀 Non-Auto segment recorded highest-ever sales, up 129.9% YoY, increasing its revenue mix to 20.8%

• 🛡️ ADS business sales grew more than 3x YoY; unexecuted ADS order backlog stood at ₹4,436.8 Cr

• ⚡ Auto-Tech Agnostic & xEV sales hit a record high, growing 22.2% YoY

• 🚗 Auto-ICE business grew 20.8% YoY; Passenger Vehicles +38.2%, Commercial Vehicles +18.5% and 2W +14.6%

• 🌎 US exports nearly doubled, Europe exports grew 32.1%, while exports to other foreign markets rose more than 3x YoY

• 📚 New business order book, representing peak annual revenue and excluding ADS, stood at ₹1,849.3 Cr

OM POWER TRANSMISSION Q1 ; REVENUE JUMPS 37%, ORDER BOOK AT ₹567 CR

• 📈 Revenue from operations grew 37% YoY to ₹121.63 Cr, driven by strong project execution

• 💰 EBITDA grew 23% YoY to ₹14.77 Cr; EBITDA margin stood at 12.15%

• 📊 PAT increased 26% YoY to ₹10.52 Cr

• 📚 Closing order book stood at ₹567.47 Cr as of June 30, 2026

• ⚡ Q1 order intake stood at ₹67.82 Cr, including GETCO and private-sector transmission orders

• 🔌 Post-quarter, received PGCIL orders for a turnkey underground cable project and GETCO order for a 66 kV underground cable project

• 🏗️ Plans to move up the value chain into 765 kV and HVDC projects and deepen private-sector presence

• 🌱 Proposed subsidiary OPTL Green Energy Pvt Ltd to pursue renewable EPC opportunities

BLACK BOX Q1 ; BACKLOG SURGES 83% YOY, TARGETS $1.3–1.5 BN FY27 ORDER BOOKINGS

• 📚 Order backlog reached an all-time high of $949 Mn (~₹8,986 Cr), up 83% YoY, nearly double the historical $450–500 Mn range

• 📝 Q1 new orders stood at $339 Mn (~₹3,208 Cr)

• 🚀 Project-led backlog grew ~50% QoQ, with large multi-year projects providing 24–36 months revenue visibility

• 🎯 Targets $1.3–1.5 Bn order bookings in FY27, implying ~32–45% growth over FY26

• 📈 Expects FY27-end backlog of $1.3–1.4 Bn, up ~65–75% YoY

• 🏦 Financial services, healthcare, public services and retail contributed ~$80 Mn of Q1 orders, diversifying growth beyond hyperscalers

• 👥 Plans to hire nearly 3,000 professionals by FY30, primarily in the US, to support larger and more complex projects

BLACK BOX Q1 ; RECORD REVENUE, BACKLOG HITS ALL-TIME HIGH OF $949 MN, TARGETS $2 BN REVENUE BY FY30

• 📈 Highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹1,719 Cr, up 24% YoY, driven by stronger backlog execution and contribution from acquired Brazilian business 2S

• 📚 Strong order bookings of $339 Mn pushed backlog to an all-time high of $949 Mn, improving revenue visibility

• 💰 EBITDA growth outpaced revenue growth, with EBITDA margin expanding 90 bps YoY

• 🤖 Increasing participation in AI-led digital infrastructure and expanding relationships with hyperscalers

• 🌎 Operates across approximately 300 strategic enterprise accounts, with a strong presence in the US

• 🎯 Targets becoming a $2 billion revenue company by FY30

• 🌐 Addressable global market estimated at $250–300 billion across data centres, networking, connectivity, cybersecurity, managed services and digital workplace

BLUSPRING ENTERPRISES ; APPROVES AMALGAMATION OF TWO WHOLLY OWNED SUBSIDIARIES

• 🔄 Bluspring New Horizon One Pvt Ltd to merge with STEAG Energy Services (India) Pvt Ltd

• ⚡ STEAG provides O&M, digital solutions and end-to-end engineering & management services to conventional and renewable power/energy sectors

• 💰 STEAG Energy Services reported FY26 turnover of ₹537.70 Cr

• 🎯 Merger aims to simplify group structure, remove multiple corporate layers and streamline decision-making

• 📉 Company expects cost savings and operational synergies through rationalisation and standardisation of business processes

• 📊 No change in Bluspring Enterprises' shareholding pattern; scheme involves no cash consideration

• 📝 Amalgamation remains subject to regulatory approvals

🟢 Outlook: Positive – Consolidation should simplify the corporate structure, improve operating efficiency and generate potential cost synergies.

AVIO SMART MARKET STACK ; EXPANDS INTO PHILIPPINES THROUGH NEW HEALTHCARE SUBSIDIARY

• 🌏 Wholly owned subsidiary BIL Healthtech Pvt Ltd has incorporated AVIO Healthcare Corporation in the Philippines

• 📊 BIL Healthtech subscribed to 22,747 shares, representing 69.99% stake in AVIO Healthcare

• 💰 Total subscription commitment stands at PHP 2.2747 million

• 🏥 New entity will undertake importing, exporting, buying, selling, distributing and marketing of medical equipment, devices, diagnostic & laboratory test kits, medicines and pharmaceutical products

• 🩺 Business scope also includes hospital & healthcare supplies and related services/projects

🟢 Outlook: Positive – Philippines entry expands the company’s healthcare business into an international market and creates a platform for overseas growth.

RAJ RAYON Q1 ; MARGINS IMPROVE, ₹650 CR EXPANSION APPROVED

• 📈 EBITDA margin improved to 8.4% vs 5.5% QoQ, despite lower volumes and supply-chain disruptions

• 🏭 Polymerization capacity enhanced from 350 TPD to 400 TPD; expects full utilization for remainder of FY27

• 🧵 Plans to commence ~10 TPD fabric production in Q3 FY27

• 🎯 Plans to double dope-dyed yarn capacity in Q3 FY27, while increasing higher-margin value-added product mix

• 💰 Board approved up to ₹650 Cr CapEx for expansion across fabric and polymerization capacity

• 🚀 Expansion targeted for full commissioning by CY2028, with FY29 expected to be first full year of commercialization

• ♻️ Upcoming expansion includes Net Zero Waste Manufacturing initiatives, biomass energy and waste-fibre recycling

JUNIPER GREEN ENERGY ; COMMISSIONS 50 MW WIND CAPACITY AT 75 MW HYBRID PROJECT

• 🌬️ Wholly owned subsidiary Juniper Green Beam Eight commissioned the entire 50 MW wind component of its 75 MW hybrid power project

• ⚡ Final 5 MW wind turbine at the project site has now been commissioned

• 📈 Aggregate operational capacity of Juniper Green Energy and subsidiaries rises to ~2,575 MWp

• 🔋 Company also has approximately 500 MWh of operational BESS capacity

🟢 Outlook: Positive – Additional commissioning expands operational renewable capacity and supports future power generation growth.

HCL INFOSYSTEMS ; WINS ₹16.67 CR TAX DISPUTE AT CESTAT

• ⚖️ CESTAT, Allahabad has allowed the company’s appeal and set aside the earlier order

• 💰 Tax demand of ₹16.67 Cr has been dismissed

• 📉 Applicable interest and equivalent penalty have also been set aside

• 📑 Dispute related to applicability of Service Tax under reverse charge on royalty paid outside India

• ⚠️ Tax department retains the right to appeal before a higher forum

🟢 Outlook: Positive – Setting aside the ₹16.67 Cr tax demand along with interest and penalty removes a significant contingent liability, subject to any further appeal.

JYOTHY LABS Q1 CONCALL ; TARGETS DOUBLE-DIGIT FY27 GROWTH, MARGIN RECOVERY EXPECTED IN H2

• 📈 Targets double-digit FY27 revenue growth excluding Pril, driven by high single-digit volume growth and pricing

• ⚠️ Q2 margins to remain under pressure due to high-cost inventory

• 💰 Management expects H2 FY27 margins to be significantly better than H1, subject to commodity-price stability and demand

• 📢 A&P spend moderated to 6.5% of revenue vs 7.8% YoY in Q1; brand investments to increase in coming quarters

• 🌾 Rural demand remains resilient, while urban consumption continues to be a concern

• 🚀 Growth strategy focused on volumes, selective pricing, premiumisation and scaling new products

PYRAMID TECHNOPLAST Q1 CONCALL ; TARGETS ~15% FY27 REVENUE GROWTH & 11–12% EBITDA MARGIN

• 📈 Management targets ~15% revenue growth in FY27

• 💰 EBITDA margin targeted at 11–12%, with FY27 EBITDA guidance of ₹80–86 Cr

• 📊 Capacity utilisation expected to improve to 70–75% for FY27 vs 62% in Q1, as export disruptions ease and demand recovers

• 📉 Polymer prices expected to decline by around ₹20/kg, which could support margin expansion despite moderating value growth

• 🏗️ FY27 CapEx planned at ₹20–25 Cr, mainly for the new Kutch facility and funded through internal accruals

• 🚀 New product line is under testing; machinery installed and commercial launch expected after customer approvals over the next 1–2 months

TECHNO ELECTRIC Q1 CONCALL ; RETAINS ₹4,000+ CR FY27 REVENUE GUIDANCE, ORDER INFLOW TARGET LIKELY TO BE EXCEEDED

• 📈 FY27 revenue guidance maintained at ₹4,000+ Cr, with EBITDA margin expected at 13–14%

• 📚 FY27 order inflow target of ₹4,000 Cr likely to be exceeded; already won ₹2,200 Cr orders with another ₹2,100 Cr at L1 stage

• 🖥️ Data Center business currently expected to contribute around ₹40 Cr revenue in FY27, with more concrete guidance likely in H2

• 🚀 Data Center revenue expected to be H2-weighted as customer deals close and workloads get deployed

• 📊 Business remains seasonally back-ended — Q1 ~15%, H1 ~40% and H2 ~60% of annual revenue

SKIPPER Q1 CONCALL ; RETAINS 15% FY27 GROWTH GUIDANCE, TARGETS ₹7,000+ CR ORDER INFLOW

• 📈 Maintains 15% revenue growth guidance for FY27 despite Q1 growth of just 4.5%; execution expected to be H2-weighted

• 📚 Targets ₹7,000+ Cr order inflow in FY27, taking closing order book to ₹10,000+ Cr

• 🌍 Export order inflow expected at ~₹1,100 Cr, up ~50% YoY

• 💰 EBITDA margin on a structural improvement path towards the long-term 12% aspiration, aided by better order mix and exit from legacy low-margin contracts

• 🏭 Stronger capacity utilization, normalization of export logistics and execution of recently won orders expected to support H2 growth

• 💳 Following the ₹433.5 Cr fundraise, FY27 finance costs guided at 3.2–3.5% of revenue

- Long-term rating upgraded to CARE BBB+.

- CVs face higher raw material inflation.
- Steel prices increased around 20%.
- Rubber prices saw steep increases.
- OEMs need 6–7% price hikes.

- Aluminium correction supports margin protection.
- Lower crude prices ease cost pressure.
- 4–5% price hike may be sufficient.

 **Demand Outlook**
- PV and 2W growth aided by GST cut.
- Low base also supports growth.
- EV adoption progressing without subsidies.
- Passenger EV launch pipeline remains key.

**CARBORUNDUM UNIVERSAL – MACQUARIE REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- U-P maintained
- Target Price: ₹940

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue grew 17% YoY
- Revenue beat expectations
- Abrasives grew 20% YoY
- Ceramics grew 16% YoY
- Electromineral grew 16% YoY

**Profitability**
- EBITDA grew 11% YoY
- PAT grew 23% YoY
- Both below estimates
- Gross margin fell 350bps

**Margin Pressure**
- Higher input costs impacted margins
- Pricing partly offset cost pressure
- Profitability remains under pressure

**Guidance**
- Revenue guidance raised
- PAT guidance lowered
- Higher costs weigh on outlook
- Overseas closure delays remain concern

**Investment View**
- Revenue growth remains strong
- Margin pressure limits earnings
- Overseas closures key monitorable

Venus Pipes & Tubes (+ve)

Good Q1-Management Commentary Steady

**VODAFONE IDEA – JPMORGAN REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- UNDERWEIGHT initiated
- Target Price: ₹9

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue beat estimates
- EBITDA beat estimates
- Revenue +3% QoQ
- EBITDA +3% QoQ
- Margin broadly flat at 43%

**ARPU & Subscribers**
- ARPU +2% QoQ
- ARPU: ₹177 vs ₹176 estimate
- Net adds: 0.3 Mn
- First positive net adds since merger

**Capex**
- Capex: ₹1,930 Cr
- Capex declined 16% QoQ
- Below JPM estimate of ₹2,300 Cr

**Key Concern**
- Bank funding remains unavailable
- Funding crucial for capex
- Funding needed to sustain market share

**Investment View**
- Q1 performance ahead of expectations
- Subscriber additions turning positive
- ARPU growth remains supportive
- Funding remains key stock risk

**VODAFONE IDEA – CLSA REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- HOLD maintained
- Target Price: ₹13

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue: ₹11,680 Cr
- Revenue +3% QoQ / +6% YoY
- EBITDA: ₹5,030 Cr
- EBITDA +3% QoQ / +9% YoY
- EBITDA in line with estimates

**ARPU & Subscribers**
- Mobile ARPU +2% QoQ / +7% YoY
- Subscribers added: 0.3 Mn
- Total subscribers: 193 Mn
- First positive net additions post-merger

**Debt Position**
- Total debt: ₹1.53 lakh Cr
- Spectrum debt: ₹1.30 lakh Cr
- Debt remained stable QoQ

**Capex & Funding**
- Planned investment: ₹45,000 Cr
- Debt funding being pursued
- Funding remains key monitorable

**Investment View**
- Subscriber trend showing improvement
- ARPU growth remains supportive
- Funding remains critical for capex

**VODAFONE IDEA – NOMURA REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- NEUTRAL maintained
- Target Price: ₹12.6

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Results broadly in line
- No major surprises
- 3-year capex program begins

**Key Trigger**
- Debt-capital raise remains crucial
- Successful fundraise could support outlook

**Key Catalysts**
- Successful debt-capital raise
- Industry tariff hikes
- Faster subscriber additions
- Strategic equity investment

**Investment View**
- Funding remains key concern
- Tariff hikes could aid recovery
- Subscriber growth remains monitorable
- Equity capital could boost confidence

**GLAND PHARMA – GOLDMAN SACHS REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- SELL maintained
- Target Price: ₹2,125
- Target price raised

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Sales grew 20% YoY
- EBITDA grew 33% YoY
- EBITDA margin: 27.2%
- Margin expanded 275bps YoY

**Margin Drivers**
- Favourable product mix
- Higher CDMO contribution
- Improved capacity utilisation
- Cost optimisation supported margins

**Business Growth**
- CDMO grew 20% YoY
- B2B grew 19% YoY
- US growth remained strong
- US revenue grew 32% YoY

**FY27 Outlook**
- Q1 growth: 15% constant-currency
- FY27 growth guidance: ≥15% CC
- RTU bag approval could add upside
- Approval expected in 3QFY27

**Valuation**
- Trades at 28x FY28E P/E
- FY26–28E EPS CAGR: 22%
- Valuation seen expensive

**Key Risks**
- Core business margin headwinds
- Cenexi turnaround may take longer
- Pre-acquisition margins may be delayed

**Investment View**
- Strong Q1 execution
- Growth outlook remains healthy
- Valuation limits upside
- Cenexi remains key monitorable

**GLAND PHARMA – JEFFERIES REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- BUY upgraded
- Target Price: ₹3,350
- Target price raised

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Strong beat vs estimates
- US market grew 32% YoY
- US growth drove performance

**FY27 Outlook**
- Growth potential raised to 15% CC
- Earlier guidance: 12–13%
- Growth outlook improving

**Growth Drivers**
- Major CDMO contract signed
- Large TAM product in-licensed
- Complex product expansion underway

**Cenexi Turnaround**
- Cenexi nearing breakeven
- New contract wins supportive
- Operational turnaround progressing

**Investment View**
- Key challenges largely behind
- Complex products offer growth
- CDMO expansion supports upside
- BUY stance strengthened

Good morning 
Nature does not hurry,
Yet everything is accomplished.

India Mobile continues to compound steadily

Q1FY27 REV increased ~4% QoQ to 299.3 Bn, while EBITDA margin expanded further to ~60.8%

The Momentum Decoder: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (+60% in 1 month)

Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (NSE:KALYANKJIL) surged after posting a massive 46% jump in quarterly revenue, which triggered aggressive institutional buying despite some minor margin pressure. Smart money completely absorbed the initial post-earnings profit booking near ₹568, driving a sharp volume-backed recovery that pushed the stock to finish strong at ₹610.

Bottom Line: The structural growth is impressive, but chasing a vertical 60% rally leaves no margin of safety; wait for a healthy pullback toward ₹570 before considering new entries.

Yield Spike & Global Impact 🌍

The US 30Yr Treasury yield hit 5.28%, a high unseen since 2007. The US-Iran conflict pushed WTI Crude from $67 to $115/barrel before settling near $76.

Rising crude halted the inflation decline, sparking hawkish Federal Reserve shifts. The 10Yr Treasury yield has strong support at 4.5% and could hit 5%. The Dollar Index remains firm near 98.

Tactical Play: Elevated yields strengthen the USD but crush Gold and emerging equities. Gold ($4,341) faces downside risk to $3,800. The Nifty 50 and Indian Rupee will face bearish corrections.

🎯 Bottom Line: Oil-driven inflation fears have reignited US Treasury yields. Expect a strong US Dollar, capped upside for Gold, and delayed rallies in global equities until yields decisively fall.

NUVAMA ON TITAN

Rating: HOLD (Downgraded from BUY) , Target Price: ₹5,241 (Earlier ₹5,030)

• Q1 FY27 performance was strong with revenue up 36% YoY, EBITDA up 57% and net profit up 65%

• Jewellery revenue grew 43% to ₹15,900 Cr; domestic jewellery revenue rose 38%, with like-for-like growth of 33%

• Jewellery EBIT included an inventory gain of around ₹370 Cr; MTM inventory benefit was around 75–80 bps

• CaratLane revenue grew around 41%; EBIT margin improved sharply to 11.5% from 6.6%

• International jewellery revenue jumped 136%, but the segment reported an ₹8 Cr EBIT loss amid GCC geopolitical disruptions

• Watches and eyewear businesses both grew 22%

• Nuvama expects MTM benefits to moderate over the next 2–3 quarters, while customs-duty benefits could continue for another two quarters

• Despite strong fundamentals, the recent share-price rally has reduced upside potential, prompting the downgrade to HOLD.
